page_text_ocr_zh:
树林里,飘下了许多枯黄的叶子。
小松鼠出去采蘑菇了,他手里挎着一只新编的小篮子。这只小篮子真美啊,那还是夏天的时候,熊猫姐姐用翠竹编了送给他的,到现在还是碧绿的呢。
整个树林里一片枯黄,再也找不到夏姐姐的踪迹了。
可是,这只小篮子上却留下了夏姐姐衣裙的一角,这是初冬的小树林里少见的一点绿。

page_text_en:
In the forest, many withered yellow leaves were falling.
The little squirrel went out to pick mushrooms, carrying a newly woven small basket. This little basket was so beautiful; it was still green, just as it was when Panda Sister gave it to him with bamboo during summer.
The whole forest was covered in withered yellow leaves, and there was no trace of Sister Xia anymore.
But on this little basket, a corner of Sister Xia's skirt had been left behind. It was a rare spot of green in the early winter forest.

summary_zh: 本页描绘了初冬的树林景象，小松鼠带着熊猫姐姐送的翠竹篮子外出采蘑菇，篮子上留有夏姐姐衣裙的一角，成为枯黄树林中少见的绿色点缀。

page_text_ocr_zh:
碧绿的小竹篮跟着小松鼠，仿佛是一片能蹦会跳的大树叶呢。
小松鼠一边紧盯着地上，采摘过冬的蘑菇，一边还想着鼹鼠老师布置的作业——用“快乐”这个词造一个句子。
他蹚过一条浅浅的小溪。呵，小溪水真凉啊。
当小松鼠爬上溪岸，抖落毛上的水珠时，他发现就在一棵老橡树底下，长着一只又白又大的蘑菇，这是初冬的树林里仅剩的一只蘑菇。
page_text_en:
The emerald green bamboo basket follows the little squirrel, as if it were a leaf that can bounce and jump.
The little squirrel, while carefully watching the ground and picking mushrooms for winter, is also thinking about the homework assigned by Mr. Mole—make a sentence using the word "happiness".
He wades across a shallow stream. Oh, the stream water is so cold!
When the little squirrel climbs up the bank and shakes the water droplets off his fur, he discovers, right beneath an old rubber tree, a big, white mushroom. It's the only mushroom left in the early winter forest.
summary_zh: 小松鼠带着翠竹篮在初冬的树林里采蘑菇，一边思考着用“快乐”造句的作业，一边蹚过小溪，最终在老橡树下发现了一只又白又大的蘑菇，是树林里仅剩的一只。

page_text_en:
The little squirrel carefully picked it. If it weren't for the fact that this was food for winter, he would have greedily bitten into it to taste it.

On his way home, he
walked past Grandma Gray Squirrel's door
and stopped by to visit her.

After several days apart, Grandma Gray Squirrel seemed to have aged even more. She said, "I'm so old that I don't even want to move. I don't think I can make it through this winter!"

Hearing this, the little squirrel was almost in tears: "No, Grandma, you'll be healthy and live until spring comes again. Then you'll be full of energy!"

After saying this, the little squirrel looked at his own basket.

page_text_en:
The big mushroom, he presented the mushroom to Grandma Gray Squirrel: "Grandma, people say that whoever eats the last mushroom in the forest will have a body as strong as an oak tree. I've found this big mushroom for you..."

"No, no, child, you keep it for yourself to eat over winter. I can't give you anything good to send you off," Grandma Gray Squirrel said, out of breath.

The little squirrel left the big mushroom and ran out from Grandma Gray Squirrel's house. He was so happy, happy just like when he received the little bamboo basket from Panda Sister in summer.

Suddenly, the little squirrel ran back. He said to Grandma Gray Squirrel, "You've already given me something precious—happiness. I can use it to make a very good sentence, and Mole Teacher will praise me.",
